class Controller:
    def __init__(self):
        self.generation = 0
        self.rows = []
        self.decisions = {}
        self.busy = False
        self._current_gen = 0
        self._finished = set()  # track which generations have been finished
    
    def start(self):
        self.generation += 1
        self._current_gen = self.generation
        self.busy = True
        # "preserves rows and decisions" - keep them as they are
        return self.generation
    
    def poll_status(self, generation, status):
        # Check if this is the latest generation
        if generation != self._current_gen:
            return False  # stale
        # Check status
        if status == 'completed':
            # Only return True ONCE
            if self._current_gen in self._finished:
                return False  # already returned True for this gen
            self._finished.add(self._current_gen)
            return True
        elif status in ('queued', 'running'):
            # queued/running keep busy
            return True  # or just keep busy=True?
        elif status == 'failed':
            # failed ends busy without fetching
            self.busy = False
            return False
        else:
            return False  # unknown status, stale
    
    def finish(self, generation, rows):
        if generation != self._current_gen:
            return False  # stale/unrequested
        if generation in self._finished:
            return False  # already finished this generation
        self.rows = list(rows)  # copies rows
        self.busy = False
        self._finished.add(generation)
        return True
    
    def set_decision(self, job_id, value):
        self.decisions[job_id] = value
